content: Prior-art survey (verified: Backrest and Uptime Kuma READMEs; Restic-ecosystem web UIs and self-hosted monitoring tools ship desktop-first web UIs with no native mobile clients; mobile access is implicit via phone browser). The established model for backup/server admin on phones is: glanceable status home, per-item list with status chips, detail screen with actions, monitor-only companion apps (Synology-style) that defer configuration to desktop. Full-configuration parity on mobile is rare and is the differentiating move (Home Assistant responsive web is the closest exemplar).
